messages:
Maya R.: Heads-up: third-party assessment booked 2026-06-15 14:00-18:00 UTC. Need a short "evidence onboarding" runbook: ephemeral RBAC, KMS delegate model, ingest presigns, audit export, and retest booking. Who picks pieces?

Joel K.: I can take ephemeral RBAC and the retire path. Plan: create assessor_temp role with no console access, session duration 1h. Will script create/delete.

Priya S.: I'll own KMS gating. We should avoid permanent Decrypt keys. Use time-scoped KMS grants and record grant ids. We'll retire-grant programmatically at session end.

Marco T.: Observability: enable a dedicated CloudTrail trail for the engagement, export to forensics bucket readonly, and snapshot at T+0 and T+end. Also capture host auditd and app request_id headers.

Maya R.: Good. Requirements from compliance: immutable evidence store, documented transfer, and a tamper-evident chain. Presigned uploads only, no upload-write in console.

Priya S.: KMS grant example (replace GRANTEE_ARN):

```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/pt-evidence-key \
  --grantee-principal GRANTEE_ARN \
  --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey EncryptDataKey \
  --name "pt-temp-upload"
```

Priya S.: Note: we grant Encrypt/GenerateDataKey for uploads; do not grant Decrypt unless absolutely required. If vendor needs to upload encrypted blobs, we decrypt on our side.

Joel K.: Assessor IAM policy draft (read-only listing + upload presign usage):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-bucket/uploads/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-bucket/readroom/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-bucket/*"}
  ]
}
```

Joel K.: We'll use presigned PUT URLs for uploads; server-side put with kms-encryption context enforced.

Marco T.: Alerting: baseline KMS Decrypt ops, and CloudTrail Write spikes. Create an alert if Decrypt > 2x baseline in 15m. Also monitor S3 object ACL changes.

Maya R.: Reading room rules: presigned GETs (TTL 48-72h), no console, no direct DB access. For live traces provide cross-account CloudWatch role with AssumeRole and MFA enforced.

Priya S.: Post-engagement tasks: retire any grants, revoke assessor_temp role, rotate the KMS key if Decrypt was granted, and archive trail export with tag `pt:<engagement-id>`. Compliance wants an evidence manifest uploaded to tracker.

Joel K.: Retest slots proposal: two 2-hour slots next week Tue and Thu 15:00-17:00 UTC. Need staffing: Maya covers Tue, Joel covers Thu. Can we reserve ephemeral infra for those times?

Marco T.: I can reserve logging-forwarder instances for the windows and schedule the CloudTrail snapshot cron. Will add tag automation.

Maya R.: On the tracker add fields: engagement_id, owner, evidence_bucket, presign_policy, kms_key_alias, grant_ids, trail_export_link, retest_slots. Tracker URL: https://redwood/secure/pt-tracker/ENG-887 (internal).

audit-bot: Preflight checklist created for ENG-887. Reminders: preflight run 2026-06-14 16:00 UTC, disable grants at 18:00 UTC on 2026-06-15.

Priya S.: One more: if we do rotate the key, plan a key rotation window and make sure service accounts that use the key are updated. Document rollback to previous key as a rare fallback.

Maya R.: Perfect. Action items: Joel = create IAM role + policy + scripts, Priya = KMS grant scripts + alert, Marco = trail snapshot + infra reservation, Maya = update tracker and calendar. Reconvene in preflight. Thanks.
